headline: Michigan State and Arizona State both need salvage mission in Week 9
subhead: Two ranked teams at 3-5 meet with postseason hopes hanging by a thread.

xFactor.why: Arizona State's defense held Boston College to 28 points last week and can exploit Michigan State's offensive inconsistency at home.

keyMatchup: Michigan State's pass rush versus Arizona State's offensive line will determine whether the Sun Devils' playmakers get time to operate downfield.
body: Both programs arrive in Tempe desperate for momentum after narrow losses that exposed fundamental issues. Tennessee dismantled Michigan State 42-27, revealing offensive breakdowns in the second half, while Arizona State fell just short at Boston College 28-25 in a game that hinged on execution in critical moments. Ranked just one spot apart despite identical records, these teams are fighting to prove they belong in postseason contention rather than watching from home.

The margin between them often comes down to turnover margin and red-zone efficiency, areas where both squads have struggled. Arizona State's home-field advantage and slightly better defensive performance in recent weeks give them the edge, but Michigan State's experience and desperation could produce a competitive, low-scoring affair. This is tournament-seeding football now, and the team that protects the ball and converts scoring chances will advance.
